address: rue Armand de Wasseige 1, Wépion, 5100, Belgium
bio: Tightly packed tables, the characteristic hum of a busy brasserie and the smiling faces of satisfied diners bear witness to the flair and talent of this chef who customises characteristic brasserie dishes. Risotto is a staple of the menu, without forgetting the knockout marriage of a 64° egg, asparagus, eel, bacon and emulsion of haddock. The pain perdu is simply out of this world!...
